title: The Offering a Word in a New Language
youtube_title: The Offering a Word in a New Language | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Yael feels shy about an one careful word in a language that was still new. Instead of pretending not to care, Yael tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
